title: FairEHR-CLP: Towards Fairness-Aware Clinical Predictions with Contrastive Learning in Multimodal Electronic Health Records
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The focus is on fairness in clinical predictions with respect to sensitive attributes such as gender, race, ethnicity, age, and socioeconomic status.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a variable or attribute studied. The research focuses on mitigating biases related to demographic factors like race, gender, age, and socioeconomic status in electronic health records.
